title: Conversation 2026-10-30: RFC-049 addressing, the smallest piece of a first registry

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: srs-rust#683 (multi-repository MCP serving) is blocked on RFC-049 (Draft Rev 3). The owner asked to look at the draft and sort it out; Claude Code put the six Open Questions to the owner, who asked for real option comparisons with trade-offs and a stated reason for each ruling, and framed the work as the first iteration of a registry.
